en: Please, do you have a Spearow? I'd trade my Farfetch'd for it!
A Spearow! Thank you. Ch'ding always carries a leek, so be careful.
That's not a Spearow. I really want a Spearow.
Oh... If you find a Spearow, will you come back?
Spearow flies all the way to the harbour and back each morning. I hope Ch'ding is happy too.
